summary:
This pass fixes the one problem the last check found: clause SPELL.bless#3 (Range: 30 feet) had no negative test. I added two to tests/srd/test_spells.py, and both pass:
- test_bless_range_is_measured_from_the_caster_not_from_another_target: BROM stands 30 ft from JOZAN and LIDDA 10 ft beyond BROM, so 40 ft from JOZAN. Casting on both is refused cleanly, which shows range isn't measured from another target.
- test_a_creature_60_feet_away_cant_be_blessed: a creature well out of range is refused, nobody is blessed and no slot is spent.
The whole file passes (78 passed) and ruff is clean. The other 54 Bless tests from earlier passes are unchanged and still pass. There are no new engine defects and no new rulings: R-12, R-13 and R-14 already settle this unit's ambiguities.

interactions.note: Range is measured from the caster to each target, never from another target. New negative test.
A target that moves beyond 30 ft stays blessed. Existing test.

interactions.with: SPELL.casting-spells.components.material-m (Component Pouch / focus can't replace a costed component)
interactions.note: Tested with symbols worth 4, 5 and 25 GP, pooled cheap symbols, a pouch top-up, and holy water.
Losing Concentration, or starting a second Concentration spell, ends Bless on every target.
A spell attack is an attack roll, so it gets the d4.
None of these get the d4.
Covered by the Bless object-target test and the Total Cover multi-target test.
Upcasting with a slot level the caster doesn't have is refused cleanly.

abuse.case: Blessing a creature that is in range of another target but not of the caster
abuse.reason: Range runs from the caster only.

abuse.case: One out-of-range target in a list of in-range targets
abuse.reason: A refused casting must change nothing.
The player-facing path must refuse cleanly too.

abuse.case: Meeting the 5 GP price with a 4 GP Holy Symbol
abuse.reason: A costed component must be worth at least the listed price.

abuse.case: Pooling cheap Holy Symbols to reach 5 GP
abuse.reason: A single item has to be worth 5+ GP.

abuse.case: Topping up a cheap Holy Symbol with a Component Pouch
abuse.reason: A pouch can't replace a costed component.

abuse.case: Holy water (the 2014 component) instead of the Holy Symbol
A refused casting that stows a weapon on the way
abuse.reason: A refusal must have no side effect.

abuse.case: Upcasting with a slot level the caster doesn't have
abuse.reason: Spending a slot the caster doesn't have.
The refusal must come before the slot is spent.

abuse.case: Keeping Bless with a second Concentration spell
abuse.reason: Only one Concentration spell at a time.

The Paladin half of the class list: paladin is in OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLASSES, so no Paladin can be made to cast Bless. The Cleric half is tested.
